title: Verificar menú de páginas y notificaciones de Live
mission: Independently verify the published Prometeo Live page shelf on a narrow mobile viewport. Check hamburger drawer, Active/Stored selection persistence, no page-wide horizontal overflow, unread page revision badge, mark-as-seen on open, folder rendering, inline page viewer/back behavior, and external-open fallback. Verify that PAGE_WATCH_REGISTRY_V1.json is projected to live/pages.json and that /wc is bound to PAGE_WATCH_PROTOCOL_V1 for future human-visible page changes. Fix bounded defects with CAS when safe; otherwise return exact evidence.
definition_of_done: Hamburger drawer opens/closes on a narrow viewport without page-wide overflow.
Adding/removing active pages persists locally and stored pages remain grouped below.
A changed page revision creates an unread dot/count and opening that page clears that exact revision locally.
Inline viewer opens selected page, returns to Live without losing state, and exposes external-open fallback.
First load baselines existing registry revisions as seen so historical pages do not spam notifications.
Public live/pages.json matches durable PAGE_WATCH_REGISTRY_V1.json after workflow publication.
Public /wc points workers to PAGE_WATCH_PROTOCOL_V1 for material human-visible page changes.
Result stays verification evidence; no Human Accepted/Served promotion is inferred.
